final_proposal.thesis: This portfolio is constructed specifically for a retired couple seeking simplicity and safety, focusing exclusively on six high-conviction names: two major banks (JPM, BAC) to anchor the required financial exposure, three iconic household brands (PG, KO, WMT) to provide defensive stability and meet the consumer mandate, and one top-tier tech stock (MSFT) for controlled growth. By strictly adhering to the constraints—minimum 11% per position, at least 19% in banks, at least 21% in everyday brands, and no more than 18% in tech—the portfolio eliminates unnecessary complexity and volatile sectors like energy or healthcare, ensuring the client can easily track their investments while preserving capital.

reasons.JPM: Selected as the primary bank holding to meet the mandatory 19% financial sector allocation, offering superior risk-adjusted returns and stability compared to peers like BAC or GS.
reasons.BAC: Included alongside JPM to efficiently satisfy the 19% minimum banking requirement while maintaining a conservative risk profile suitable for retirees.
reasons.PG: A core 'everyday brand' with low volatility and stable margins, essential for meeting the 21% consumer goods allocation and providing capital preservation.
reasons.KO: Offers the lowest volatility in the universe among household brands, ensuring stability and fitting the client's preference for recognizable, defensive names.
reasons.WMT: Provides strong retail presence and brand loyalty, complementing PG and KO to robustly exceed the 21% everyday brand threshold.
reasons.MSFT: The only tech position allowed, selected as the highest quality/momentum name to maximize growth potential within the strict 18% technology cap.
